description: This file defines the AjaxResponseSubscriber class, which handles AJAX response processing and request detection within Drupal, including browser-specific workarounds and event subscription.

classes.name: AjaxResponseSubscriber
classes.description: Handles AJAX response processing and request detection, subscribing to kernel response and request events.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the subscriber with a closure for processing attachments.

methods.name: onRequest
methods.description: Detects AJAX requests and sets a flag in the Html utility class.

methods.name: onResponse
methods.description: Processes AJAX responses, modifies headers and content for browser compatibility, and adds security tokens.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers event handlers for response and request events.
